highlights_headline: Upcoming servicing fixes make mask-filtered glyph rendering safer when consecutive font-scaler loads disagree.

bullets.lead: Reloaded glyphs use their own rendering state
bullets.detail: Mask filtering uses the reloaded glyph's path and copies overlap only between matching byte-per-pixel masks. Full plane strides are preserved for clipped embossed glyphs, avoiding stale outlines, sub-byte buffer overwrites and corrupted or uncleared mask planes. Managed bindings are unchanged.
